Recommended design: preregister five arms—RecHarness SASRec baseline; full TF–IDF recurrence residual; recency-only residual with semantic similarity disabled; uniform text pooling with recurrence/recency weights removed; shuffled-text residual using a fixed within-category item–text permutation. Match residual dimensions, trainable capacity, optimizer and training budget across controls; keep baseline settings identical. Retain all four categories, preprocessing seed=0, training seed=42, and identical 200 users/category with fixed 99 unique negatives, evaluation seed=42. Report category HR@10 and their unweighted macro-average. These are sampled-candidate results, not full-catalog accuracy: sampled metrics can reverse model rankings ([Krichene–Rendle](https://research.google/pubs/on-sampled-metrics-for-item-recommendation/)).

Save each user’s binary hit for every arm. Bootstrap paired user records within each category, preserving model pairing; recompute four-category macro differences over 10,000 resamples and report 95% intervals, absolute percentage-point gains and discordant wins/losses ([paired bootstrap](https://docs.scipy.org/doc/scipy/reference/generated/scipy.stats.bootstrap.html)). Intervals describe user uncertainty conditional on these checkpoints, seeds and candidates; they exclude training variability and adaptive selection. Preallocate the 43,200 GPU-second budget, including failures, and equal tuning allowances. Fix checkpoint cadence and selection rules beforehand; count every checkpoint and hyperparameter comparison. Repeated validation optimization introduces selection bias that bootstrap intervals cannot remove; label selected gains exploratory ([Cawley–Talbot](https://jmlr.csail.mit.edu/beta/papers/v11/cawley10a.html)).

Prespecify within-category strata: training-history length, history/target title-description availability, and target popularity from training interaction counts. Report subgroup sizes and paired gains without subgroup tuning. Mechanistic evidence requires gains over all controls, including shuffled text—not merely baseline improvement. Keep splits and evaluator unchanged; access no test labels, unavailable metadata or external data.
